messages:
sam: Quick thread to align on Private deploy packaging + upgrade lanes for VPC/on-prem. Want a compact set of onboarding modes + clear rollback semantics so field can operate without late-stage ops.

sam: Proposal: three onboarding modes with increasing network ownership: "edge-relay" (fastest), "nat-proxy" (customer-managed nat/pinning window), "peer-bgp" (full peering + IP sovereignty). Separate installer surface from operator-shim contract.

trinh: Edge-relay is the one we can ship as GA quickly. Key MVP asks: automated preflight that prints exact remediation steps and a short-run smoke test that proves data plane egress path.

noah: nat-proxy needs a well-defined "pin window" policy: how long we guarantee the same egress IP for a tenant. Suggest default 7 days with opt-in longer windows. Also need a breach metric when IP changes mid-window.

emily: For peer-bgp, legal + security require a route-filter checklist, AS path constraints, and signed manifest confirmation from customer netops before we flip routes. That pushes peer-bgp to post-GA.

infra-bot: Created ticket: PRD-6010 "Private deploy onboarding modes + upgrade lanes" -> https://go/repo/PRD-6010

sam: Minimal manifest example for edge-relay (for docs):
```
mode: edge-relay
egress: redwood-proxy
ip_guarantee: none
preflight: [tls, dns, control-plane-reachability]
```

trinh: Owners: installer preflight -> trinh; upgrade choreography + per-tenant pins -> noah; console + manifest rollback UX -> emily; docs/field runbook -> sam.

noah: Rollout plan idea: pinned-version per-tenant. Upgrade flow = canary (5%) -> staged cohorts -> full. Always keep ability to revert to last manifest. Implement automated smoke revert if handshake fails for >3 consecutive checks.

emily: Console UX requirement: surface pending manifest diff, show operator-shim hash, and offer "revert" which triggers the revert job and notifies customer netops. Add audit event for every revert.

trinh: Air-gap note: preflight must emit a signed report file (preflight-report.json + signature) that field can upload. Operator-shim should accept a signed manifest in that flow.

noah: Acceptance criteria for GA (edge-relay): 1) preflight schema passes for 3 sample topologies, 2) console shows manifest+revert, 3) two pilot customers onboarded, 4) rollback completes within SLO.

emily: Timeline: GA (edge-relay) in 5w if owners hit sprint goals. nat-proxy targeted for M1 (10-12w) with IP pin tests. peer-bgp in M2 after legal/network sign-off.

infra-bot: PRD-6010 labels updated: +private-deploy +field-beta +due 2026-06-01

sam: Action items:
- trinh: preflight runner + remediation messages
- noah: per-tenant pin design + automated revert hooks
- emily: revert UI + audit events + manifest diff UI
- sam: draft field runbook + pilot invites

sam: Please react with :thumbsup: to lock the plan or add objections.

trinh: :+1:

noah: :+1: will sketch pin API by EOD

emily: :+1: will mock the revert flow next week

sam: Thanks everyone, converting thread to RFC and assigning PRD-6010 owners.
